profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Principal Financial Group | Leveraging experience as a servant leader to help people from all walks of life to save enough, protect enough, and have enough in retirement.
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the financial services industry. Strong engineering professional with a Associate of Arts and Sciences - A.A.S. focused in Computer Software Development from Indian Hills Community College.
